description: Point-in-time per-merchant wallet balance for a marketplace (no date range), one row per merchant. Dimensions: os_client_id, merchant_id, merchant_name. Returns the raw remaining_budget_amount_usd (USD) plus the marketplace conversion_factor (USD->marketplace currency); the Python layer computes remaining_balance = (usd * factor) when usd >= 0.01 else 0. Not aggregated, so it carries a placeholder metric.

os_client_id.description: OnlineSales client id of the merchant.

merchant_id.description: Marketplace seller id of the merchant.

remaining_budget_amount_usd.description: Raw remaining wallet budget in USD (before currency conversion). The Python layer multiplies this by conversion_factor with a >=0.01 floor to get the balance in marketplace currency.

conversion_factor.description: USD -> marketplace-currency conversion factor from static_currency_conversion. Multiply remaining_budget_amount_usd by this to get the wallet balance in marketplace currency.

placeholder_metric.description: Constant 0. Row-level passthrough report with no aggregated metric; KAM requires at least one metric to fetch.

query.REPORTING: SELECT __ATTRIBUTES__, __METRICS__ FROM `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.clients` AS clients JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.marketplace_clients` AS mc ON clients.agency_id = mc.agency_id JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.static_currency_conversion` AS scc ON scc.from_currency = 'USD' AND scc.to_currency = mc.currency WHERE clients.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' AND clients.seller_id IS NOT NULL AND clients.seller_id != '' AND mc.marketplace_client_id != clients.client_id AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY __ATTRIBUTES_GROUP_BY__;
